response:
DIAGNOSIS: the archive now delivers a clear ranking. The best result is CheapTwoChannelAccrualState (fmb 2.45, FF5 alpha +3.0%, t 3.42, Sharpe 0.33) — combining two economically independent quality channels beat both parents (2.2%/t2.70 and 1.3%/t1.46), which says the binding constraint is *measurement noise in the quality leg*, not the mechanism. Second, every construct whose dispersion comes from a price-scaled yield still gives negative FF5 alpha (HardAssetBookToMarket: fmb 2.29, alpha −1.3%), confirming the ratio family is exhausted. Third, the *amplifier* is now the untested dimension and it is clearly consequential, not cosmetic: CFO/P and E/P amplifiers produced negative alphas, the hard deep-value gate produced fmb −0.83 and Sharpe −0.18 despite a positive alpha (unstable subsample), while the plain B/M rank works. This batch therefore does two things: keeps consolidating the quality composite (which third channel adds?), and systematically tests three economically different amplifiers, plus one new temporal channel.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: ThreeChannelQualityCheap
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(SUMRANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(wcap, sale), 5)), SUMRANK(TREND(RATIO(dp, at), 5), SUB(TS_MAX(RATIO(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), sale), 5), RATIO(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), sale))))))
HYPOTHESIS: Accounting quality supporting cheapness has three separable dimensions — working-capital discipline, depreciation adequacy, and the completed unwinding of past accrual bloat — and a cheap firm scoring well on all three has earnings that are simultaneously cash-converted, conservatively costed, and free of an unreversed overhang.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Two-channel averaging raised the FF5 alpha from 2.2% to 3.0% and the t-stat from 2.70 to 3.42, so the natural test is whether the third channel that also produced standalone positive alpha (accrual unwind, +1.6%, t 1.85) adds further independent information or is redundant with the working-capital slope. The three legs use different accounting objects (level slope, long-lived-asset charge, distance from own historical peak), so their errors should be weakly correlated.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: QualityCompositeWithTaxCheck
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(SUMRANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(wcap, sale), 5)), SUMRANK(TREND(RATIO(dp, at), 5), MA(RATIO(txp, at), 3)))))
HYPOTHESIS: External verification by the tax authority is a distinct form of earnings validation from internal cash conversion, so adding persistent accrued taxes to the quality composite should identify cheap firms whose profits are real to both the cash cycle and the taxman.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The tax channel standing alone had the highest Fama-MacBeth t-stat of any quality leg tested (2.57) but a weak alpha (+0.6%), the mirror image of the working-capital trend's profile, so combining them targets the study's exact weakness — jointly strong cross-sectional and portfolio evidence. Paired with Signal 1 it identifies which third channel carries incremental information rather than just averaging noise.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: BroadValueAmplifiedQuality
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), ZSCORE(SUMRANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(wcap, sale), 5)), TREND(RATIO(dp, at), 5))))
HYPOTHESIS: Book-to-market is a noisy proxy for cheapness — it misprices asset-light and write-down-scarred firms — so a two-measure value composite (book and sales relative to price) should identify the firms where accounting quality matters more accurately than book-to-market alone.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The amplifier determines *where* the accrual interaction is switched on, and the archive shows it materially changes results (yield-based amplifiers turned the alpha negative, the hard gate destabilized the portfolio), so improving its measurement is a substantive change rather than a relabeling. Sales-to-price is available for firms with distorted book equity, which should also stabilize the extreme buckets.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: OwnHistoryCheapWithQuality
EXPRESSION: MUL(TS_RANK(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 5), ZSCORE(SUMRANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(wcap, sale), 5)), TREND(RATIO(dp, at), 5))))
HYPOTHESIS: Mispricing is best identified relative to a firm's *own* valuation history rather than the cross-section: a firm trading at the cheap end of its five-year book-to-market range while its accounting quality is improving has suffered a price decline unmatched by fundamentals.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: A time-series cheapness amplifier is structurally orthogonal to HML — it contains no permanent industry or business-model value tilt, only firm-level valuation deviation — so it should isolate the accrual-quality interaction with even less factor contamination than cross-sectional B/M. This is the first valuation channel in the study measured in the time-series dimension, and it directly tests whether the interaction is about being cheap or about having become cheap.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: ConvexCheapQualityWeight
EXPRESSION: MUL(MUL(RANK(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), RANK(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), ZSCORE(SUMRANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(wcap, sale), 5)), TREND(RATIO(dp, at), 5))))
HYPOTHESIS: The value-trap mechanism intensifies nonlinearly with cheapness, because the deeper the discount the more the market is betting reported earnings will not persist, so accounting quality should receive convexly increasing weight as book-to-market rises.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The hard B/M>1 gate tested this convexity but failed on cross-sectional evidence (fmb −0.83, Sharpe −0.18) because it discards the entire cross-section into a zero mass point whose size swings with the market cycle; squaring the cheapness rank delivers the same convexity smoothly, keeps every firm ranked, and holds portfolio composition stable. It repairs the specific failure mode while retaining the economics the gate was designed to capture.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: CheapWithDeceleratingAccrualBuild
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(RANK(NEG(ACCEL(RATIO(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), sale))))))
HYPOTHESIS: The turning point matters more than the level or the slope: a cheap firm whose non-cash working capital intensity is still rising but decelerating is at the inflection where accrual pressure on future earnings peaks and begins to reverse, and the market prices the stale trend rather than the change in trend.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The archive has tested accrual levels, one-year changes, five-year slopes, distance-from-peak and volatility, but never the second derivative, which is the earliest observable evidence that management is regaining working-capital discipline. It is a genuinely new temporal concept using the same well-covered balance-sheet inputs, so any result is attributable to the timing concept rather than to data availability.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---CRITIQUE ThreeChannelQualityCheap---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: A defensible incremental extension of the best archive signal, but the third leg (distance of non-cash WC/sales from its own 5-year max) is mechanically close to the negative 5-year slope of wcap/sales already in the composite, so the claimed independence is doubtful, and the nested SUMRANK silently weights the legs 1/2-1/4-1/4 rather than equally as the hypothesis implies.

---CRITIQUE QualityCompositeWithTaxCheck---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The motivation is genuinely diagnostic — pairing a high-fmb/low-alpha leg (accrued taxes) with a high-alpha/low-fmb leg — but it remains a third-leg substitution in an existing composite, the nested SUMRANK weights the tax channel only 1/4, and txp is sparsely/zero-reported in ways that may mix a "reports the item at all" effect into the quality score.

---CRITIQUE BroadValueAmplifiedQuality---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Replacing the amplifier with a book-plus-sales value composite is a substantive rather than cosmetic change and is well-argued (B/M misprices asset-light and write-down firms), but sales-to-price is itself a long-known anomaly and the archive already showed sales-yield constructions producing negative FF5 alpha, so the expected improvement is speculative.

---CRITIQUE OwnHistoryCheapWithQuality---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: This is the first time-series valuation dimension in the study, is internally consistent (high TS_RANK of B/M = cheap versus own history = positive expected sign) and plausibly orthogonal to HML, though with annual data a 5-period TS_RANK is a very coarse, noisy amplifier that may blunt the interaction.

---CRITIQUE ConvexCheapQualityWeight---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Squaring an already-uniform cheapness rank is a near-cosmetic monotone reweighting of the exact interaction already tested as CheapTwoChannelAccrualState, and it does not implement the claimed nonlinearity in any economically distinct way — it merely tilts the signed product toward high-B/M names, so any change in results will be uninterpretable scaling noise rather than evidence about convexity.

---CRITIQUE CheapWithDeceleratingAccrualBuild---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: The second derivative of non-cash working-capital intensity is a genuinely new temporal concept relative to the levels, one-year changes, slopes, peak-distance and volatility already tested, and the sign is consistent; the main risks are that acceleration on annual data is very noisy and that the expression rewards a flattening *decline* as well as the intended decelerating build, which is not what the hypothesis describes.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: CheapWithRevenueCashCollection
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), ZSCORE(RANK(MA(RATIO(COALESCE(recch, 0), sale), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Revenue quality is the specific accrual channel behind the classic value trap: a cheap firm that persistently collects its sales in cash has real revenue, whereas one whose reported sales keep migrating into receivables is recognizing revenue it will not collect, so its cheapness reflects earnings that will be written down.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
REASONING: The receivables channel has only ever been tested in this study inside a gen-0 additive sales-yield composite whose dispersion came from the yield and whose FF5 alpha was therefore negative; measured as a three-year *state* and used as the dispersion leg under the HML-neutral amplifier, it is a new and economically sharp channel rather than a reweighting of an existing signal. Deflating by sales rather than assets ties the measure directly to revenue recognition, and averaging over three years removes the single-year collection-timing noise that killed one-year accrual legs earlier in the archive.
